resources.string: Demo PIN: 1234. Set your PIN in the phone app.
Allow body sensors so the watch can measure your heart rate.
Caregiver alerted.\nIf you are OK, enter PIN (%1$d s)
Alarm still running – tap to open
Your caregiver has been alerted with your location.
False alarm. Your caregiver is being told you are fine.
Headband is not sending data. Check that it is on, worn and charged.
Brain signal is weak. Adjust the headband so the sensors touch the skin.
Headband movement sensor is not sending data. Restart the headband.
Watch data are not reaching the phone. Keep the phone close.
Heart rate is not measured. Tighten the watch strap.
Watch movement sensor is not sending data. Restart the watch.
Phone not connected. Keep the phone close and the EpiProt app on.
Seizure detection is LIMITED until this is fixed.
Seizure detection may be weaker until this is fixed.
Seizure alarms do NOT work until this is fixed.
No consent for monitoring yet. Give it in the EpiProt phone app (Settings → Privacy & consents).
Tap to open EpiProt and resume.
No skin contact: %1$s. Press the pad back on or replace it.
Replace the pad %1$s: it is drying out.
Headband battery low (%1$s %%). Charge it soon.
Headband battery almost empty (%1$s %%). Charge it now.
Headband is charging. Seizure detection is OFF until the headband is worn again.
Headband was switched off in the app. Seizure detection is OFF until it is switched on again.
Headband was disconnected in the app. Seizure detection is OFF until you connect it again.
Headband was unpaired from the phone. Seizure detection is OFF until a headband is paired.
Only urgent warnings vibrate. Alarms always do.
Phone battery low (%1$s %%). Charge it: if the phone switches off, seizure alarms stop.
Phone battery almost empty (%1$s %%). Charge it now, or seizure alarms will stop.
Watch battery low (%1$s %%). Charge it soon. While it charges there is no heart rate; detection goes on with the headband.
Your caregiver gets a message with your location
Your caregiver got a message with your location. Sit or lie down somewhere safe.
The message goes out as soon as the phone is back. Ask someone nearby for help now.
The headband software is being updated. Seizure detection is OFF until the headband is worn again.
Before a shower: your caregiver is alerted if you do not come out
Take the headband off; keep the watch on. Shower, do not take a bath, and do not lock the door.
Tap \"I am out\" when you are done.
Are you out of the shower?
Tap \"I am out\". Without an answer in 2 minutes your caregiver is alerted.
You did not answer, so your caregiver was told to check on you.
